dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings defined by high-intensity light perimeters approximately 5-15 pixels wide, exhibiting jagged edge boundaries and sharp negative gradients toward darker interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity white punctate clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized along the left lateral margin and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region, with a secondary linear arrangement of three high-intensity blobs extending posteriorly from the upper flipper insertion point.
